scripts.build:android: npm --prefix ../desktop run build:phone-debug && cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.build:ios: npm --prefix ../desktop run build:phone-debug && cap sync ios && xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' -derivedDataPath ios/DerivedData build
